name: Pexiganan (MSI-78)
haemolysis_value: Human erythrocytes: 10-20% at 13 µg/ml; 50-60% at 50 µg/ml
known_stability_notes: Salt/serum exposure and proteolysis can reduce in vivo exposure.
known_solubility_notes: Generally soluble at screening concentrations in aqueous buffer.
notes: Positive benchmark with broad antibacterial activity. Clinical phase III efficacy did not exceed standard care.

name: Magainin 2 (magainin-II)
known_stability_notes: Short cationic helix; activity can diminish in physiologic salts and serum.
known_solubility_notes: Good water solubility in solution.
notes: Positive benchmark with clear antibacterial activity and low hemolytic signal.

name: LL-37 (human cathelicidin)
known_stability_notes: Human derived sequence; activity can diminish in physiologic salts and serum.
known_solubility_notes: Soluble in water but binds host proteins/lipids, reducing free concentration.
notes: Positive natural reference scaffold with broad antibacterial activity and manageable baseline properties.

name: Iseganan (IB-367)
haemolysis_value: Human erythrocytes: 90-100% at 99.6 µM; 0-10% at 2 µM
known_stability_notes: Disulfide-rich scaffold raises synthetic complexity and oxidative heterogeneity.
known_solubility_notes: Formulation sensitive at higher concentrations; free peptide tends to be limited by cytotoxicity window.
notes: Liability-oriented scaffold: activity present but narrow therapeutic index and high host-cell risk.

name: Temporin-SHf
known_stability_notes: Very short peptide; lower proteolytic stability and rapid loss in complex matrices.
known_solubility_notes: High hydrophobic content makes formulation and selectivity control challenging.
notes: Near-negative/weak example: poor antifungal potency (MIC >100 µM) and likely weak translational potential.

name: Cecropin A
target_microbe: Escherichia coli ATCC 25922; Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923
haemolysis_value: Low hemolysis reported at active range
known_stability_notes: Proteolysis in serum/plasma likely limits systemic exposure, but stable enough in short assays.
known_solubility_notes: Generally water soluble up to screening levels; low formulation burden.
notes: Positive: broad activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens in vitro.

name: Cecropin B
known_stability_notes: Serum stability not strongly characterized in older reports.
known_solubility_notes: High solubility in dilute water buffers typical for assay workflows.
notes: Positive: classic broad-spectrum cecropin motif with improved Gram-negative potency.

name: Pleurocidin
target_microbe: Escherichia coli ATCC 25922; Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923
cytotoxicity_value: Low in standard cell viability screens
known_stability_notes: Helical peptide; serum and protease stability can drop with longer pre-incubation.
known_solubility_notes: Generally soluble in buffered saline; improves with low ionic strength.
notes: Positive: marine fish-derived template with broad antibacterial and low toxicity profile in early studies.

name: Melittin
target_microbe: Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923; Escherichia coli ATCC 25922
haemolysis_value: High hemolysis above 5 µg/ml in human erythrocytes
known_stability_notes: Very strong hemolytic membrane activity; unsuitable without masking/modification for systemic use.
known_solubility_notes: Forms strongly active aggregates in high ionic-strength biological media.
notes: Liability: very potent but clinically problematic for mammalian toxicity and safety window.

name: Protegrin-1 (PG-1)
target_microbe: Escherichia coli ATCC 25922; Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC 27853
haemolysis_value: Moderate hemolysis in RBC panels at higher doses
known_stability_notes: Disulfide-rich cyclic scaffold improves conformational rigidity but adds oxidative handling complexity.
known_solubility_notes: Good synthetic yield, but disulfide isomerism and formulation control required.
notes: Positive with very strong activity and defensin-like membrane effects; safety and synthetic complexity matter for scale.

name: Indolicidin
known_stability_notes: High tryptophan content may reduce metabolic stability in plasma.
known_solubility_notes: Generally soluble at formulation-relevant concentrations.
notes: Positive, short Trp-rich scaffold with broad activity and fast synthetic accessibility.

name: Buforin II
target_microbe: Escherichia coli ATCC 25922; Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 25923
cytotoxicity_value: Lower cytotoxicity relative to parent buforin
known_stability_notes: Helix-hinge-helix motif supports membrane translocation but can be sensitive to proteolysis.
known_solubility_notes: Well-behaved in water and low-salt buffers.
notes: Positive: intracellular mechanism class with strong activity and potential intracellular target leverage.

name: Histatin 5
modifications: C-terminal amidation occasionally reported in some studies
known_stability_notes: Salivary peptide is protease-sensitive in wound-like matrices.
known_solubility_notes: Highly polar and generally soluble in aqueous solution.
notes: Positive antifungal scaffold with clear niche against Candida; useful anchor for selectivity-focused designs.

name: Lactoferricin B
target_microbe: Escherichia coli ATCC 25922; Candida albicans ATCC 10231
haemolysis_value: Low hemolysis at micromolar active range
modifications: Disulfide bond noted in some lactoferricin constructs
known_stability_notes: Milk-protein fragment; protease exposure and metal-bound environments can alter activity.
known_solubility_notes: Generally soluble and easy to formulate for topical uses.
notes: Positive: fragment from host defense protein with broad antimicrobial and low mammalian safety concerns at screening doses.

name: BMAP-18
haemolysis_value: Lower hemolysis than longer BMAP-27 analogues
known_stability_notes: Cathelicidin truncation improves selectivity but still protease-sensitive.
known_solubility_notes: Good aqueous handling, suitable for rapid library testing.
notes: Positive/optimization scaffold: shorter fragment tuned for lower hemolysis while retaining MIC activity.

name: Temporin A
known_stability_notes: Very hydrophobic AMP with narrow therapeutic separation in many reports.
known_solubility_notes: Limited water handling above active concentrations without acidification.
notes: Near-negative/weak candidate: short hydrophobic frog peptide with limited antimicrobial depth in serum-like conditions.

name: Temporin L
haemolysis_value: Dose-dependent hemolysis at higher peptide concentrations
known_stability_notes: Strong helix-forming antimicrobial, but potency can deteriorate in complex fluids.
known_solubility_notes: Amphipathic scaffold; formulation needed for long-term stability.
notes: Positive but watch dose-dependent host-cell toxicity; useful for potency-first optimization set.

name: Pardaxin-1
cytotoxicity_value: Not broadly optimized for mammalian safety
known_stability_notes: Known to disrupt biological membranes; analog optimization commonly needed.
known_solubility_notes: Long amphipathic segment can self-associate; requires careful formulation design.
notes: Liability: potent pore-forming activity but broad membrane disruption raises selectivity concerns.

name: Ponericin G1
known_stability_notes: Insect venom-derived cationic peptide; protease susceptibility likely in serum.
known_solubility_notes: Generally good solubility in aqueous buffers at screening concentrations.
notes: Near-negative/weak-to-moderate screen set: keep for diversity but validate potency and serum stability.

name: KR-12 (LL-37 Cationic Fragment)
known_stability_notes: Truncated cathelicidin motif; often used as minimal motif anchor in optimization experiments.
known_solubility_notes: Small fragment soluble and easy to formulate; reduced hydrophobic burden.
notes: Near-negative/weak set by itself; useful as design seed for truncation and tuning studies.
